map-my-city.label: Map My City (deployed as Map My San Jacinto)

shots.name: hero
shots.state: City Hall selected, lookup rows filled, assessor sidebar and legend open (match-cut target for CityDraw)

shots.name: lookup
shots.order: rotated (v1): starts on its poster, the property report
shots.state: type 595 S San Jacinto, pick the suggestion, zoom, rows fill, open the property report

shots.name: layers
shots.order: rotated (v1): starts on its poster, the 2014 imagery
shots.state: zoning on with its legend; the imagery slider steps 2014 to 2026 over post-2014 subdivisions, no parcel selected
shots.poster: Jul 26, 2014 imagery under the zoning layer

shots.name: measure
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame

shots.poster: the open Measure panel over the Civic Center block

shots.name: createmap
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame
shots.state: Create Map in rectangle mode: a box drag picks the City-owned 432-190-011/012/013 (and nothing else), Create Map, Hatch fill, the Planning template, scrolled to its title block
shots.poster: Create Map open in rectangle mode over the three City parcels

shots.name: buffer
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame
shots.state: Proximity Buffer with 300 ft entered: click the SJUSD school parcel, the ring and its parcels, Mailing Labels (Avery 5160; private owners blurred by redact.js, public agencies readable), then Print Map: the subject site map
shots.poster: the Proximity Buffer panel with 300 ft, before the click

shots.name: hero
shots.state: dark theme: City Hall parcel at z21, turf + concrete drawn (shapes injected through the app's own plEncode into the permalink hash), Draw panel with rows and donut

shots.name: base
shots.state: dark theme: the hero view with the drawings, glass sheet and chrome hidden: the map under the glass

shots.name: draw
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame
shots.state: dark theme: Add Turf and its four corners, then Add Concrete, the third corner snapping to the turf's corner and the fourth to its edge; rows and donut update
shots.poster: City Hall with nothing drawn yet

shots.name: composition
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame
shots.state: dark theme close-up: Edit, then a concrete corner dragged out while the rows, total and donut follow live; Edit again to save
shots.poster: the restored plan beside the Yard Composition panel

shots.name: share
shots.order: played once: the poster is the first frame
shots.state: dark theme: Share in the rail, the Download & Share panel, Copy Link and its status toast (the clipboard write is stubbed; no PDF is generated or downloaded)
shots.poster: the restored plan with the Draw panel
